howItWorks.title: How Law Market works
howItWorks.subtitle: Search, compare, and book fixed-price legal services — with a guarantee behind every listing.
howItWorks.step1Text: Browse by practice area or search for a specific service. Every price is fixed and shown in GEL before you commit.
howItWorks.step2Text: Review verified lawyer profiles, experience, languages, and client feedback from real cases in Georgia.
howItWorks.step3Text: Reserve your service directly. Your payment is protected until the agreed work is delivered.
howItWorks.guaranteeText: Every lawyer is vetted before joining. If a service isn't delivered as promised, our team steps in to make it right — no runaround.

about.title: About Law Market
about.subtitle: Making trusted legal help easier to find, for everyone.
about.missionText: Law Market connects people and businesses in Georgia with verified, experienced lawyers — with transparent, fixed pricing and no surprises. We believe finding legal help should feel as straightforward as booking any other trusted service.
about.value1Text: Every lawyer is reviewed before they can list a single service.
about.value2Text: Prices are fixed and visible upfront — no hidden consultation fees.
about.value3Text: If something goes wrong, our team steps in to make it right.

legal.placeholderNotice: This is placeholder legal text for prototype purposes only and should be replaced with reviewed legal copy before launch.
legal.termsSection1Text: Law Market is a marketplace connecting clients with independent, verified lawyers. By using the platform, you agree to interact respectfully and provide accurate information when booking services.
legal.termsSection2Text: Services listed on Law Market are provided by independent lawyers, not by Law Market itself. Prices are shown upfront; payment handling and booking confirmation will be described here once available.
legal.termsSection3Text: Lawyers are reviewed before joining the platform. Details of the satisfaction guarantee, refund conditions, and dispute resolution will be described here.
legal.termsSection4Text: Law Market facilitates connections between clients and lawyers but is not itself a law firm and does not provide legal advice.
legal.privacySection1Text: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, contact details, and information related to the services you search for or book.
legal.privacySection2Text: Information is used to operate the platform, connect clients with lawyers, and improve our services.
legal.privacySection3Text: We do not sell personal information. Limited information is shared with lawyers you choose to book, solely to fulfill your request.
legal.privacySection4Text: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us.
